description: Creates a new GitHub gist from one or more files. Returns structured data with gist ID, URL, visibility, file names, description, and file count.

content.description: Inline content as filename-to-content map (e.g., {'script.py': 'print(1)'}). Creates gist from inline content instead of file paths. Either files or content must be provided.

files.description: File paths to include in the gist. Either files or content must be provided.

name: gist-create
title: Gist Create
